title: Thyristor Rectifier Voltage Controller (Three-Phase)
text: Discrete-time DC-link voltage PI control for thyristor rectifiers, 4 inputs, 1 output; {Loop filter proportional gain} sets the loop filter K p, {Loop filter integral gain} sets the loop filter K i, {Proportional gain} sets the controller K p, {Integral gain} sets the controller K i, {Thyristor pulse width (rad)} sets the pulse width, {Pulse ordering}, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the block sample time, {Time constant voltage filter} sets the dC voltage filter τ and {Filter DC voltage} sets the dC voltage filter. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Loop filter proportional gain
params.values: Loop filter K p 2 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Loop filter integral gain
params.values: Loop filter K i 20 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Pulse ordering
params.values: Pulse ordering rule Sequential device order (default) | Natural order of commutation

params.name: Time constant voltage filter
params.values: DC voltage filter τ 0.001 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Filter DC voltage
params.values: DC voltage filter option on (default) | off
